sections.description: Private rehearsal library for choirs: songs, voice parts, audio or official YouTube embeds, PDF scores, and a sticky player.
sections.changelog:
0.4.63

  • Demo distribution (sandbox caps, Demo data page, nightly reset, *.compath.ee host lock)
  • Arabic/CJK slug transliteration via intl; fallback song-{id}

0.4.61

  • Per-track Audio / YouTube source switch in the song editor
  • YouTube tracks open the official embed player on the song page (video stays visible)
  • Song list shows a YouTube icon next to PDF and public badges

0.4.60

  • Add WordPress roles Singer (listen) and Voice Leader (manage songs); names stay in English
  • Song admin for Voice Leader and Administrator; Settings for Administrator only
  • Full private library requires Singer, Voice Leader, or Administrator

0.4.59

  • Song list: globe icon for public songs when logged in
  • Small gap between PDF and globe badges

0.4.58

  • Force HTTPS for PDF and audio attachment URLs on SSL pages (fixes mixed-content blank PDF/waveforms in wp-admin)

0.4.57

  • Keep the songs library URL permanently at /rehearsal/ (never localize the page slug)

0.4.56

  • Fix Russian/Estonian translation mojibake in .l10n.php catalogs
  • Ship UTF-8 PO/MO/l10n.php for et, et_EE, and ru_RU

0.4.55

  • Fix blank PDF canvas in the song editor when SoftMe metabox width is 0
  • Defer PDF.js paint until the viewer has a usable layout width

0.4.54

  • Song editor embedded PDF preview available in Lite and Pro
  • Includes SoftMe/Softica sticky player icon and editor PDF visibility fixes

0.4.53

  • Theme-proof sticky player piano and close icons against SoftMe/Softica button color overrides
  • Editor PDF re-renders when the Sheet Music metabox becomes visible

0.4.52

  • Repair ghost/duplicate Lite rows in active_plugins when only one folder exists on disk
  • Migration wizard: list active_plugins entries and one-click repair

0.4.51

  • WordPress.org catalog build: full feature set without Lite track caps (separate wporg zip via build-wporg-zip.sh)
  • Remove global sanitize_title filter; song slugs only via targeted post save hooks

0.4.50

  • Universal install/replace: finds choir-rehearsal/ or compath-choir-rehearsal/ and replaces contents instead of adding a second copy
  • Removes extra Lite folders after install (songs stay in the database)
  • Update check merges all sources and picks the highest version (fixes stale 0.4.21 fallback on sites still on 0.4.38+)
  • Redirects to Plugins when an update is available

0.4.49

  • Migration wizard for duplicate Lite folders (keep one, remove extras, songs safe)

0.4.48

  • Keep updates in the installed plugin folder (no second Lite copy)
  • Duplicate notice lists active Lite paths

0.4.47

  • GitHub zip installs into choir-rehearsal/ again (no duplicate plugin on existing sites)

0.4.46

  • Text domain matches WordPress.org slug (compath-choir-rehearsal)

0.4.45

  • Settings hook for Pro song backup (export/import ZIP)
  • Clearer notice when two Lite folders are installed

0.4.44

  • Fix piano keys sticking after press on the public song player

0.4.43

  • Do not fatal when an old choir-rehearsal folder is still loaded; show an admin notice
  • Use a single plugin folder: compath-choir-rehearsal

0.4.42

  • Renamed to Compath Choir Rehearsal (slug compath-choir-rehearsal) for WordPress.org
  • GitHub and .org packages use folder/asset name compath-choir-rehearsal

0.4.38

  • Mobile: PDF fullscreen close (X) ports above sticky player and recording dock
  • Fullscreen toolbar Close control as a reliable exit on small screens

0.4.37

  • Fix PDF Previous/Next page turning

0.4.36

  • Desktop player can scrub microphone recordings
  • Mic uploads convert to seekable WAV when needed

0.4.35

  • Fix song page freeze from recording dock MutationObserver
  • PDF viewer avoids redundant re-render loops

0.4.34

  • Mobile floating recording controls (record/pause/stop/cancel)
  • Pause and resume the same microphone take

0.4.33

  • Larger recorder piano/metronome icons
  • Metronome only in recording panel
  • No white frame on public player waveform
  • PDF expand exit X on song pages

0.4.32

  • Metronome tool with tempo slider (sticky player + recording panel)
  • Recording start row: Start / piano / metronome (70% / 15% / 15%)

0.4.31

  • Sticky player: clean scrubber (no title overlay); time and close on the right

0.4.30

  • Song editor recorder: piano icon beside Start recording

0.4.29

  • Sticky player piano: 2-octave scrollable Web Audio keyboard

0.4.28

  • Sticky player waveform behind scrubber with no white track
  • PDF expand fits to width; matching X close control
  • Pinch-zoom keeps scale after fingers lift

0.4.27

  • Sticky player waveform sits behind the scrubber in a compact single-row bar

0.4.26

  • Editor shows track waveform (filename moved to hover/a11y)
  • Sticky player waveform under the scrubber

0.4.25

  • Blue waveform between track name and Play/Upload
  • Waveforms generated from each track audio file

0.4.24

  • Play buttons stay blue with white icon across themes
  • PDF full-screen expand; sticky player remains below
  • PDF pinch-to-zoom

0.4.23

  • WordPress.org package omits GitHub updater file (Plugin Check)
  • readme.txt Tested up to 7.1

0.4.22

  • WordPress.org ready packaging (no GitHub self-updater in .org zip)
  • PDF.js bundled locally (no CDN)
  • Settings copy for WordPress.org updates

0.4.21

  • Fix: updater treats non-2xx GitHub API responses as failures
  • Durable update.json fallback via latest release asset
  • Settings shows check result notices (available / up to date / failed)

0.4.20

  • Fix: PDF score preview no longer blanks in the song editor after the form loads
  • PDF.js loads without credentials first (avoids hung credentialed fetches in wp-admin)
  • Song save no longer deletes an attached PDF when the metabox field is missing or mime is unexpected

0.4.19

  • Share: one-tap copy with confirmation toast
  • Mobile Share toast stays on screen
  • Editor Play icon shows a clear white triangle

0.4.18

  • Song permalinks auto-transliterate any language title to Latin
  • Permalink edits in the song editor save correctly
  • Existing non-Latin song URLs migrate on upgrade

0.4.17

  • Song page Share icon: copy public or private link

0.4.16

  • Make public control on song editor (mobile icon)
  • Public songs list and listen without login
  • Private songs still gated when login required

0.4.15

  • Editor matches public song card
  • Embedded PDF with swipe pages
  • Track rows with Upload/Record/Play icons

0.4.14

  • Sticky player close (×) button
  • Pro: PDF icon on songs with attached scores

0.4.13

  • Mobile editor back link at top
  • Pro: floating PDF view while recording

0.4.12

  • Song editor Play preview is Pro-only; Pro benefit copy updated

0.4.11

  • Song editor Play button opens sticky player for the selected track

0.4.10

  • Demo titles: Demo Song 01, 02, … for correct A–Z order

0.4.9

  • Demo load creates 25 songs so pagination appears

0.4.8

  • Settings: Load demo songs and Delete all songs

0.4.7

  • Pro search matches Cyrillic and other Unicode titles
